name: Aeon Co. (M) Bhd.
summary: Aeon Co. (M) Bhd. operates and manages a retail chain of departmental stores and supermarkets in Malaysia. The company operates in two segments, Retailing and Property Management Services. It sells clothing, food, pharmaceuticals, and household products, as well as other merchandise. The company operates general merchandise stores, shopping malls, shopping centers, pharmacies, and shopping malls. In addition, it offers financial and credit services; property management service. Further, the company operates myAEON2go, an e-commerce platform; and foodpanda app for shopping online.
